'''Keemlin Rai''' is a young [[Kandori]] boy.

==Appearance==
He is a young messenger boy, only a few days shy of his fourteenth naming day.

==Activities==
He is the son of [[Heeth Tower]]'s Commander, [[Malenarin Rai]]. He demonstrates awareness, courage and maturity for his young age. When the [[Trolloc]]s are approaching, he is on top of the list to act as a messenger, and is sent south to warn the capitol of [[Chachin]]. However, he sends Tian instead because Tian's mother has already lost four sons. Upon hearing this, Keemlin's father acknowledges and honors him as a man with the gift of a sword.{{ref/book|13|p}} A huge force of [[Draghkar]] then attack from the sky and a massive army of [[Trolloc]]s marches towards the Tower. It can be assumed he doesn't survive the conflict.
